method: Enumerate committed paths with git ls-tree -r --name-only COMMIT; read contents with git show COMMIT:PATH. Working-tree edits excluded.

test_source.method: AST walk over tracked tests/**/test_*.py; count FunctionDef and AsyncFunctionDef nodes whose names start with test_, including nested definitions. Not a count of collected or passing pytest cases.

migrations.method: Tracked files under db/postgres/migrations/; all 76 have .sql suffix.

python_modules.method: Tracked .py files under src/, governance_core/, agents/.
